note: What a server sends to show a ping on the map to everyone meant to see it. The header names the champion that placed the ping, as source does.

fields.name: atX
fields.note: Where the ping sits, along one ground axis, in world units.

fields.name: atY
fields.note: Its height, in world units. A client does not use it to place the ping.

fields.name: atZ
fields.note: Where it sits, along the other, in world units.

fields.name: target
fields.note: The unit pinged, or zero where a place was pinged instead.

fields.name: source
fields.note: The unit that placed it.

bits.name: category
bits.note: Which sort of ping.

bits.name: playSound
bits.note: Set where the client plays a sound for it. That a client acts on it this way is not confirmed.

bits.name: showInChat
bits.note: Set where the client writes a line about it. That a client acts on it this way is not confirmed.

bits.name: throttled
bits.note: Set where the player is pinging too often: a client places no ping, plays nothing and announces nothing, and only writes a notice in its own chat. That a client acts on it this way is not confirmed.

bits.name: unused
bits.note: Unused; a server writes zero.
